claims.claim_text: The objective of IFRS S1 is to require an entity to disclose information about all sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s cash flows, its access to finance or cost of capital over the short, medium or long term.
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 3 requirement text.

claims.claim_text: For the purposes of IFRS S1, these risks and opportunities are collectively referred to as "sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects".
A complete set of sustainability-related financial disclosures presents fairly all sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect an entity’s prospects.
To identify sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect an entity’s prospects, an entity applies paragraphs B1–B12.

Fair presentation requires disclosure of relevant information about sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects and faithful representation of that information in accordance with IFRS S1.
To achieve faithful representation, an entity provides a complete, neutral and accurate depiction of sustainability-related risks and opportunities.
Fair presentation requires an entity to disclose information that is comparable, verifiable, timely and understandable.

Fair presentation requires an entity to disclose additional information if compliance with specifically applicable IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards is insufficient to enable users to understand the effects of sustainability-related risks and opportunities on cash flows, access to finance and cost of capital over the short, medium and long term.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports

claims.claim_text: An entity discloses material information about sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects.
To identify and disclose material information, an entity applies paragraphs B13–B37.
An entity’s sustainability-related financial disclosures are for the same reporting entity as the related financial statements.

An entity provides information in a manner that enables users to understand connections between the items to which the information relates, such as connections between various sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports

claims.claim_text: An entity provides information in a manner that enables users to understand connections between disclosures within its sustainability-related financial disclosures, such as connections between governance, strategy, risk management and metrics and targets disclosures.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports

claims.claim_text: An entity provides information in a manner that enables users to understand connections across its sustainability-related financial disclosures and other general purpose financial reports published by the entity, such as its related financial statements.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports

claims.claim_text: An entity identifies the financial statements to which the sustainability-related financial disclosures relate.

Data and assumptions used in preparing sustainability-related financial disclosures are consistent, to the extent possible considering IFRS Accounting Standards or other applicable GAAP, with corresponding data and assumptions used in preparing the related financial statements.
When currency is specified as the unit of measure in sustainability-related financial disclosures, the entity uses the presentation currency of its related financial statements.

Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise in specified circumstances, an entity provides disclosures about governance processes, controls and procedures used to monitor and manage sustainability-related risks and opportunities.

Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise in specified circumstances, an entity provides disclosures about its strategy for managing sustainability-related risks and opportunities.

Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise in specified circumstances, an entity provides disclosures about its risk management processes to identify, assess, prioritise and monitor sustainability-related risks and opportunities.

Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise in specified circumstances, an entity provides disclosures about metrics and targets, including performance and progress towards targets set by the entity or required by law or regulation.
In identifying sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect an entity’s prospects, an entity applies IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards.

In addition to IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, an entity refers to and considers the applicability of the disclosure topics in the SASB Standards, and may conclude they are not applicable in its circumstances.

In identifying applicable disclosure requirements about a sustainability-related risk or opportunity, an entity applies the IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard that specifically applies to that risk or opportunity.

In the absence of an IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard that specifically applies to a sustainability-related risk or opportunity, an entity applies judgement to identify information that is relevant to users’ decision-making and faithfully represents the risk or opportunity.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports

claims.claim_text: In making the judgement described in IFRS S1.57, an entity refers to and considers the applicability of the metrics associated with the disclosure topics included in the SASB Standards, and may conclude those metrics are not applicable in its circumstances.
